title: Returns
text: Unused products can be returned within 14 days of delivery. A return must be approved before the customer ships the item. Refunds are issued after warehouse inspection; never promise an instant refund.

title: Damaged items
text: For an item damaged on arrival, apologize, collect the order number and create a priority support ticket. The customer does not need to pay return shipping. Do not promise a refund before review.

title: Delivery delays
text: Check the order status before answering. If tracking has not updated for five days, create a delivery investigation ticket. Do not invent a delivery date.

title: Refund timing
text: After a return passes inspection, refunds are sent to the original payment method within 5–7 business days. Banks may take additional time to display the payment.

title: Privacy and identity
text: Never reveal an order unless the supplied email matches the order email. Ask the customer to use a private support channel for identity verification.
